# The Seed set the Tail search is held to. Every line is one game:
#
#   goal  pieces  cap  beam_width  seed
#
# The Tail switched on must not change what the Tail switched off reaches for any
# line here: a game that is won stays won, clears the same Lines, and costs no
# more Evaluations. This is ticket 04's "Tail search never changes a result the
# beam already reaches", which §9.2 gate 5 then guards on every push.
#
# Two Dataset configurations, at the width ticket 01 measured against. The set is
# deliberately small: it runs in the debug profile where the suite lives, and the
# Tail fires on roughly one game in a thousand, so a wide set adds minutes and no
# coverage. The seed that *does* fire (453) has its own test.
